name: @sve/workflow-service
description: SVE Workflow & Approval Foundation — a reusable orchestration/approval engine (definitions, versions, steps, instances, tasks, decisions) that future business domains (HRMS, iClaims, Payroll, Data Vault, ...) plug their approval needs into. Depends on platform-services/identity's Identity/RBAC/Audit contracts and platform-services/organisation's manager-routing contract (imported by source path — see README.md); does not duplicate their implementation, and neither package depends on this one.
